description: This Java source file contains JUnit test cases for the ThingCommandEnforcement component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies enforcement of access policies and permissions when querying and modifying 'things' within the system, including various scenarios involving ACLs, policies, and error conditions.

classes.name: ThingCommandEnforcementTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for verifying policy enforcement logic in the Eclipse Ditto system. Tests various access control scenarios including ACLs, policies, and error handling when querying or modifying 'things'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and mock actors before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Tears down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: rejectByAcl
methods.description: Tests rejection of access when the 'thing' has an empty ACL, expecting a ThingNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: rejectByPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection based on missing or empty policy, expecting a ThingNotAccessibleException.

methods.name: rejectQueryByThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Verifies that a ThingNotAccessibleException is properly propagated when the entity cannot be accessed.

methods.name: rejectUpdateByThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Verifies enforcement when updating a 'thing' that is not accessible.

methods.name: rejectQueryByPolicyNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Checks handling of PolicyNotAccessibleException during a read request.

methods.name: rejectUpdateByPolicyNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Checks handling of PolicyNotAccessibleException during an update request.

methods.name: rejectCreateByOwnAcl
methods.description: Tests rejection of create requests when the ACL entries are not authorized.

methods.name: rejectCreateByOwnPolicy
methods.description: Tests rejection of create requests when the policies are not accessible or do not grant permission.

methods.name: acceptByAcl
methods.description: Ensures that access is granted when the ACL permits the operation.

methods.name: acceptByPolicy
methods.description: Verifies successful access enforcement via policies granting permissions.

methods.name: acceptByPolicyWithRevokeOnAttribute
methods.description: Tests policy enforcement with revoked permissions on specific attributes.

methods.name: acceptCreateByOwnAcl
methods.description: Verifies creation with own ACL entry is accepted.

methods.name: acceptCreateByInlinePolicy
methods.description: Checks creation when using an inline policy that authorizes the operation.

methods.name: acceptCreateByImplicitPolicyAndInvalidateCache
methods.description: Tests creation with implicit policy and cache invalidation behavior.

methods.name: testParallelEnforcementTaskScheduling
methods.description: Simulates concurrent enforcement tasks to verify scheduling and message delivery order.

methods.name: acceptCreateByInlinePolicyWithDifferentId
methods.description: Verifies creation with different policy ID than the 'thing' ID.

methods.name: testCreateByCopyFromPolicy
methods.description: Helper method testing creation by copying from a policy, with different expected responses based on lockout settings.

methods.name: rejectCreateByInlinePolicyWithInvalidId
methods.description: Checks rejection when inline policy has an invalid ID.

methods.name: rejectCreateByInvalidPolicy
methods.description: Verifies rejection for invalid policy data during creation.

methods.name: transformModifyThingToCreateThing
methods.description: Ensures that modify commands are transformed correctly into create commands when applicable.

methods.name: newEnforcerActor
methods.description: Creates a new enforcement actor with specified parameters.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders with authorization context and schema version for tests.

methods.name: newThing
methods.description: Helper method to create a new 'thing' builder with default settings.

methods.name: newThingWithPolicyId
methods.description: Creates a 'thing' JSON object with an associated policy ID.

methods.name: newThingWithAttributeWithPolicyId
methods.description: Creates a 'thing' JSON object with an attribute and associated policy ID.

methods.name: getReadCommand
methods.description: Returns a standard retrieve command for the test 'thing'.

methods.name: getModifyCommand
methods.description: Returns a standard modify (feature) command for the 'thing'.
